Thanks @{{assignee}}, #{{number}} is yours!

To get started:

1. Fork the repository, then follow the Quick start of [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/NexyPy/nexy/blob/develop/CONTRIBUTING.md): it installs everything and runs the checks in about two minutes.
2. Read the issue again: it names the files to start from and what "done" means.
3. Open a draft pull request against `develop` early, even a small one, and ask here whenever something is unclear.
4. No news for 14 days frees the issue for someone else, with no hard feelings: a comment or a draft pull request keeps it yours, and `/take` brings it back.

Nexy is a young project, and its community is how it grows. If you like what you see:

- leave a star on the repository;
- follow Nexy on LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/nexy-dev/
- join the community on Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/nexyframework/
- invite people around you who could try Nexy, test it or contribute.

None of this is required to contribute: your pull request is what counts. Welcome aboard!
